name: DSH Voice Conversation
author: RedHunt07
description: Hands-free Italian/English voice conversations for DSH, automatic prompt submission after a pause, listening recovery after replies, inline dock preserving chat and tools, and optional local Whisper/Piper speech backend.
compatibility: DSH 0.2.0-rc.2; Node.js 22+; Linux web profile. Initial release; real-microphone acceptance testing pending.
attribution: Independent MIT fork of ZG2017/dsh-plugin-voice-loop. Original copyright preserved.
